bio.text: Kimberly Alexander, a Democrat, has represented Georgia House District 66 since being sworn in on January 14, 2013; she was elected in the 2012 general election to the newly created seat.
Her official biography says she is a native of Paulding County, grew up in Hiram, and now lives in neighboring Douglas County.
It says she holds a master's degree in administration from Central Michigan University and a bachelor's degree from Morris Brown College.
